Name: Quick Chest Color
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows you to change a chest's color without having to open the chest inventory menu. It also lets you copy one chest's color to another.


[b][size=4]Change Color[/size][/b]

To change a chest's color, hover over the chest with the mouse, then use the mouse scroll wheel or customizable up and down keys (default [b]up and down arrow keys[/b]) to switch colors.

Holding down a modifier key (default [b]left alt[/b]) causes the switch to occur in half-step increments, meaning you can blend two adjacent colors. You can set this to happen by default in the config.


[b][size=4]Copy / Paste Color[/size][/b]

To copy a chest's color, hover over the chest with the mouse, then press the copy / paste key (default [b]mouse middle button[/b]). This will copy the chest's color into memory.

To paste a copied color, hover over the target chest with the mouse, hold down the mod key (default [b]left alt[/b]) and press the copy / paste key (default [b]mouse middle button[/b]).


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
